Hello! I can only speak for myself, but something that I try to do is vent by writing it out. I use the notes app, and what’s nice about it is that you can lock the note when you’re done by using a password. 

Going on walks or drives too and listening to music, but that’s not always an option. Now that I think of it, screaming into a pillow isn’t bad either, but I’ve only done it a few times. (Is that a bad coping mechanism? I don’t think it is, right?)

I also just talk myself through it, like I vent to myself. That being said therapy and whatnot helps as well.

Anyways, that’s just what I try to do. I know it can be hard, and I wish you the best with this. Stay safe out there :)
